mapper.select: SELECT m.meter_id,ft.fee_code,m.initial_reading,(SELECT mr.reading_value FROM meter_reading mr WHERE mr.meter_id=m.meter_id ORDER BY mr.reading_at DESC,mr.meter_reading_id DESC LIMIT 1) latest_reading FROM meter m JOIN fee_type ft ON ft.fee_type_id=m.fee_type_id WHERE m.status='ACTIVE' AND ft.fee_code IN #{n}
SELECT meter_id FROM meter_reading WHERE reading_at=#{readingAt} AND meter_id IN #{id}
